card.name: Small linking words before test or dose terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, the, within, from, on, a) in clinical label text, just before a test, body, time window or basis term such as serum, two weeks, the body, or a mg/m2 basis.

modes.label: Or between specimen types
modes.description: The word 'or' joining two lab sample types, before serum.
modes.example: Must have had 2 negative urine<< or>> serum pregnancy tests with a sensitivity of at

modes.label: Time-window linking words
modes.description: Words like within or from that lead into a time span or removal from the body.
modes.example: LAIV should not be administered<< within>> 2 weeks before or 48

modes.label: Dose comparison basis
modes.description: The word on or a just before a body surface area or mg/m2 basis.
modes.example: equivalent to 20 times the maximum recommended human daily dose (MRHD) of 60 mg on<< a>> surface area (mg/m 2 )
